name: Real Estate CRM
heroTitle: Real Estate CRM for Property Developers in Bangladesh
summary: Manage property enquiries, site visits, bookings, and installment collections in one workspace. Give Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, and Accounts a shared view of each customer from first enquiry through post-sale support.
metaDescription: Real estate CRM for property developers in Bangladesh. Manage leads, site visits, unit inventory, booking approvals, installments, and customer service.

features.title: Lead capture and assignment
features.description: Bring enquiries in from website forms, Meta Lead Ads, CSV, and Excel. Flag duplicate phone numbers and route leads to the right sales team.

features.title: Follow-ups and site visits
features.description: Schedule follow-ups and property visits, log calls and notes, and see which enquiries need attention.

features.title: Property inventory and booking approvals
features.description: See which units are available, on hold, booked, or sold. Route bookings to a sales manager for approval and hand approved sales over to Customer Service.

features.title: Installments, payments, and receipts
features.description: Create installment schedules, track overdue balances, and issue receipts after Accounts verifies a payment. Record cash, cheque, bank transfers, bKash, Nagad, and Rocket payments.

features.title: Customer service
features.description: Assign customers to service executives and manage customer documents, support tickets, and payment follow-ups from one record.

features.title: Sales and collections reports
features.description: Track lead sources, campaign performance, sales activity, and collections with role-based access to reports and exports.

localization: Available in Bangla and English, with amounts displayed in BDT using lakh and crore formatting.
demoTitle: See how Real Estate CRM fits your sales process
demoDescription: Walk through a sample enquiry, from the first follow-up and site visit to booking approval, installment tracking, and a verified payment receipt.
